cover: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original wide editorial cover for an English LeoGuoLabs engineering article, 'Git, the AI-Native Way: From Intent to Verified Delivery'. Create an elegant 16:9 conceptual illustration, not a screenshot. A precise miniature engineering workspace on a deep navy background: on the left, a simple cream task brief card feeds a small understated brass-and-teal mechanical agent arm; the arm arranges versioned file cards onto branching rails in the middle; the rails join at a review gate and lead to a finished, illuminated website model on the right. Human intent is the input, the agent performs the work, and the state changes remain visible. Premium matte paper, fine metal, editorial model photography, warm controlled lighting, generous negative space in the upper third. Palette bone white, dark navy, muted teal, restrained burnt orange. Only render these exact English words: large 'GIT', below it 'THE AI-NATIVE WAY', and small 'LeoGuoLabs'. No other typography, no product UI, no code, no logos, no octocat, no neon, no futuristic holograms. Clear composition with useful visual separation between the task brief, local versioning, review, and delivered artifact. Original visual, sophisticated and practical.
